name: Data Engineering & Big Data
description: Modelling, moving and processing data at scale: pipelines, warehouses and lakes, Spark and streaming.

nodes.name: Data engineering
nodes.desc: What data engineers build: sources, sinks, batch versus streaming and the modern data stack.

nodes.name: Analytical SQL
nodes.desc: Window functions, CTEs, grouping sets and writing efficient analytical queries.

nodes.name: Data modelling
nodes.desc: Star and snowflake schemas, facts and dimensions, and when to denormalise.

nodes.name: File formats
nodes.desc: CSV, JSON, Avro and Parquet; row versus columnar storage and compression.

nodes.name: ETL & ELT
nodes.desc: Extracting, transforming and loading data, and pushing transforms into the warehouse.

nodes.name: Orchestration
nodes.desc: Pipelines as DAGs: scheduling, retries, backfills and idempotent tasks.

nodes.name: Data quality
nodes.desc: Validation checks, data contracts and testing pipelines before bad data spreads.

nodes.name: Batch pipeline
nodes.desc: Build a scheduled pipeline that ingests a public dataset daily, validates it and loads a warehouse.

nodes.name: Data warehouses
nodes.desc: Columnar MPP warehouses, clustering, materialised views and cost-aware queries.

nodes.name: Data lakes
nodes.desc: Object storage, lake layouts and lakehouse table formats with ACID transactions.

nodes.name: Distributed storage
nodes.desc: How HDFS-style and object stores split, replicate and place data across machines.

nodes.name: Partitioning
nodes.desc: Choosing partition keys, bucketing and dealing with data skew.

nodes.name: MapReduce
nodes.desc: The map, shuffle and reduce model and why it scales.

nodes.name: Apache Spark
nodes.desc: DataFrames, lazy evaluation, transformations versus actions, and the shuffle.

nodes.name: Spark tuning
nodes.desc: Reading query plans, joins strategies, caching, partition sizing and avoiding spills.

nodes.name: Spark job
nodes.desc: Process a multi-gigabyte dataset with Spark and publish aggregated tables.

nodes.name: Event logs & Kafka
nodes.desc: Partitioned logs, producers, consumer groups, offsets and retention.

nodes.name: Stream processing
nodes.desc: Windows, watermarks, late data, state and exactly-once processing.

nodes.name: Change data capture
nodes.desc: Streaming database changes from transaction logs into downstream systems.

nodes.name: Governance & lineage
nodes.desc: Catalogues, lineage, access control and handling personal data.

nodes.name: Streaming pipeline
nodes.desc: Build a real-time pipeline from a source database through a log to live aggregates.
